speaker: Doctor
text: Given the recent viral illness and isolated vertigo without hearing loss, this presentation is highly suggestive of vestibular neuritis. I will proceed with a physical examination to check for nystagmus and perform the head impulse test to confirm the diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: I am observing your eyes for nystagmus and will now perform the head impulse test to assess your vestibular function. Please keep your eyes fixed on my nose as I quickly turn your head to the side.

text: I am keeping my eyes fixed on your nose as you turn my head. The spinning sensation feels a bit more intense when you move my head quickly.

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive head impulse test and absence of hearing loss confirm vestibular neuritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Vestibular Neuritis
